notes.title: Achievements Issue Addressed
notes.content:
For some time, the achievements were being wonky. Some would unlock and some would not, even though the game code never was changed. The game engine used was updated, however, and this might have triggered an issue.

After spending several hours on this, I've concluded a few things.
1) Using a [i]demo build[/i] in Steam apparently does not grant achievements - this made me think something was broken when it actually wasn't.
2) I cleared [i]AppData / Roaming / RenPy / Disturbed-1531778811[/i]
3) Rebuilt the game with the game engine up-to-date (cleared persistent data and forced recompile)
4) Booted up Steam, updated, verified, and started getting achievements on an alternate steam account...

Seeing that my alt account can get the achievements, I'm retiring from this issue. What a headache this has caused. I apologize if you, like me, were having problems with this. Hopefully, this or the recent update helps.

notes.title: Disturbed | 4 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26380148/1ce3868c012f4eb64608e30448e18c9ed5154519.png[/img]

[h2]Where Has the Time Gone?[/h2]
Four years in the past feels so distant and strange. So much has happened and changed, and yet in some ways, things have stayed the same. I speak of the thrill of adventure, the uneasiness of the unknown, and that [i]disturbed[/i] feeling you get when things go wrong. What an inspiration to read about and see so many adventurers traverse the unknown! Happy 4 Years of Disturbed!

[h3]New Death Added[/h3]
Even though there are other projects going on, I couldn't sit by this year as I have in the past. So, regarding this post, the game has received a subtle update that will add some goosebumps to your arms. This may be a little brutal to newcomers but veterans will get a spook from it too I hope. I may need to tweak it later when more people play, but for now, go ahead and wander around. Give the game another go.[i] If for no other reason, it is now the season.[/i]

[spoiler]A vicious spirit has been released to haunt those who travel the lands of Aramor. Be careful not to wander too long.[/spoiler]

Feedback will be appreciated. [i]I was a bit hesitant about adding it in Disturbed Beyond Aramor, but for some reason, it found its way here instead.[/i] ːheartpieceː

notes.title: Updating Disturbed to a newer version
notes.content:
[b]Now that Disturbed: Beyond Aramor is out, it is time to update the game that started it all.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/617620/Disturbed_Beyond_Aramor/

Due to the outdated version of the engine [b]Disturbed[/b] runs on, players have had problems playing the Linux version of the game. This updated version should fix this problem, while also breathing some life back into the game with updated visuals. Progress has only just begun, but hopefully within the next month or two, this update will be ready and available for all to enjoy. More updates to come! :dba_Sacred:

notes.title: Only a week before the planned launch of Disturbed: Beyond Aramor
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/2d3c231d347ebdb2e3d83b22537ce18197082b18.png[/img]
There is so much that I want to share, but doing it in a post like this, it's hard to get the message across. The creation of this game has been quite a journey, and even now, there are a lot of kinks to work out before the game is ready for the public to see... But I'm optimistic! Sometime I'll have to make a documentary or something, but for now, I just wanted to inform everyone that [b]May 18th is the intended release date[/b]. [i]Follow and wishlist the game if you haven't already. It's going to be good![/i]

That being said, I hope to be a bit more active on the announcements and being transparent. Even after the game release, I hope to improve and make adjustments where needed. 'Disturbed' still needs a Linux fix, so I'll be working on that soon. I need to sit down and improve my website too, so that's another thing. There will always be something left to work on I guess. As mentioned above, I'd like to get a documentary out there of the creation process of Disturbed: Beyond Aramor.

I look forward to sharing more with everyone soon. Thanks. :warhorse:

notes.title: An update regarding Disturbed 2
notes.content:
I want to take a moment to make a post regarding the state of Disturbed 2. How things are going, the release date is looking to be in March. I hope to have a solid date by February. As of things right now, the game's story is undergoing refinements and testing. Much of the artwork still needs to be animated, but I hope that this can all be done and polished by the end of February. It is exciting to have things come together, and it will be really interesting to see how people will handle it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26380148/50a11e286f0bbf27fc040e2de3c9a99d001c646d.jpg[/img]

I had very high ambitions at the start of this project and I didn't really know what I was doing. I didn't want to replicate the same Disturbed experience without adding to it, so I let my imagination go wild... and it kinda took over. I went through several story changes and as I wrote, I kept adding to it. I realize now, looking back, how important it is to set parameters and to keep things simple. I feel I wasted a lot of time experimenting with things when I should have focused my time elsewhere. The reason I share this is that the advertised story and gameplay is a little different than I was hoping for. Over the next couple weeks, I plan on having the store page updated with new (and better) screenshots and descriptions that will be more accurate. Regarding the translations for the game, these may be delayed depending on how things go. Due to the project taking way longer than planned, I can't make any guarantees.

[IMG]https://68.media.tumblr.com/1f6d5bc153e6e6d904a14e2b981d233b/tumblr_p2rob7lrWo1v8u3k8o1_1280.gif[/IMG]

I want to thank those who have encouraged me to keep going, along with those who have bought the 'support dlc'. I appreciate the time people have taken to review Disturbed and to share their thoughts. My goal with this next game is to embrace the experience of adventure with a heavy emphasis on exploring the environment. Stay tuned for more updates as the game comes closer to completion.

Thank you. ːwarhorseː

notes.title: State of Disturbed
notes.content:
This is just an update on what I am up to right now, and the state of Disturbed and Disturbed 2.

[h1]Disturbed[/h1]
So a couple weeks back I tried to get a DLC for trading cards lined up for Disturbed, and it got approved - but after a chat with steam, it would be an inefficient way of getting trading cards to those interested (charging a $1 or so for the DLC). This being said, I'm not sure trading cards will ever be available for Disturbed, unless there is 3 or so DLC for it that people would buy, then trading cards would be a more realistic feature to add.

So, I'm not sure if I should just leave Disturbed alone and work on a 2nd one (which I will talk about below), or if I should work on small individual adventures and release them as DLC? I have created a new forum for game design. Yes, I can read the reviews for the game, and I have been doing that. This can be an opportunity for people to be more involved.

[h1]Disturbed 2[/h1]
I have been spending a lot of time developing a storyboard and the direction for this game. Right away, this project is more ambitious with a clear story, characters, and minor combat system. Deaths are more logical consequences, and the game will be more focused on a story rather than living through the metaphor Disturbed was based on. The art style will be similar however, and if you are looking for death, you will surely find it haha. In short, it will be a much longer and involved game. (At least, that is the idea)

More details will be on the Distubed forum under game design.

[h1]iBlackPen[/h1]
For those who know me a bit, I am attending college and am hoping to wrap up a web design major hopefully within the next year. It has been keeping me busy, but I'm trying to devote a fair amount of time to the development of Disturbed. Also, the iblackpen website has plans for revisions.

For those of you celebrating Thanksgiving, be safe while traveling/etc.ːwarhorseː

Thanks for reading.
